verdict.rationale: Kong provides logging/monitoring plugins (kong-gh-3), OpenTelemetry metrics export for gateway and AI traffic (kong-docs-61), AI Gateway log access (kong-docs-69/73), and Konnect for monitoring control/data plane status (kong-docs-46), covering metrics, logging, and tracing integrations for platform engineers. Missing for 10: deeper first-party docs/examples on distributed tracing integrations (e.g. Zipkin/Jaeger) for core gateway traffic beyond AI-specific OTel, and independent hands-on validation of observability accuracy at scale.
